```{r,echo=F,fig.dim=c(4/2*1.2,3/2*1.2),results="asis",fig.align='center'}
drawit = function(TFs = c(F,F,F,F),col=rgb(1,0,0,0.4),lwd=2){
    par(mar=c(0,0,0,0))
    plot(0,0,"n",xlim=c(-1,1),ylim=c(-3/4,3/4),axes=F,ann=F)
    th = seq(0,2*pi,pi/100)
    xc1 = -1/4
    yc1 = 0
    xc2 = 1/4
    yc2 = 0
    r = 1/2
    x1 = xc1+r*cos(th)
    x2 = xc2+r*cos(th)
    y1 = yc1+r*sin(th)
    y2 = yc2+r*sin(th)
    if(TFs[4]){
        polygon(c(-1,-1,1,1),c(-1,1,1,-1)*3/4,col=col)
        polygon(x1,y1,col="white")
        polygon(x2,y2,col="white")
    }
    th60 = seq(-pi/3,pi/3,pi/300)
    thbig = seq(-2*pi/3,2*pi/3,pi/300)
    xI = c(xc1+r*cos(th60),xc2+r*cos(th60+pi))
    yI = c(yc1+r*sin(th60),yc2+r*sin(th60+pi))
    xbo = c(xc1+r*cos(th60),rev(xc2+r*cos(thbig)))
    ybo = c(yc1+r*sin(th60),rev(yc2+r*sin(thbig)))
    xao = c(xc1+r*cos(thbig+pi),rev(xc2+r*cos(th60+pi)))
    yao = c(yc1+r*sin(thbig+pi),rev(yc2+r*sin(th60+pi)))
    
    if(TFs[1]){
        polygon(xao,yao,col=col)
    }
    if(TFs[2]){
        polygon(xI,yI,col=col)
    }
    if(TFs[3]){
        polygon(xbo,ybo,col=col)
    }
    lines(x1,y1,lwd=lwd) 
    lines(x2,y2,lwd=lwd)
    polygon(c(-1,-1,1,1),c(-1,1,1,-1)*3/4,lwd=lwd)
    text(-1/4-0.45,0.45,"A")
    text(1/4+0.45,0.45,"B")
}

labs = list(c("\\emptyset"),
            c("A \\cap B'","(A' \\cup B)'"),
            c("A \\cap B","(A' \\cup B')'"),
            c("A' \\cap B","(A \\cup B')'"),
            c("A' \\cap B'","(A \\cup B)'"),
            c("A"),
            c("(A \\cap B')\\cup(A'\\cap B)"),
            c("B'"),
            c("B"),
            c("(A \\cap B)\\cup(A'\\cap B')"),
            c("A'"),
            c("A \\cup B","(A' \\cap B')'"),
            c("A \\cup B'","(A' \\cap B)'"),
            c("A' \\cup B'","(A \\cap B)'"),
            c("A' \\cup B","(A \\cap B')'"),
            c("\\xi")
            )

tfs = list(c(F,F,F,F),
           c(T,F,F,F),
           c(F,T,F,F),
           c(F,F,T,F),
           c(F,F,F,T),
           c(T,T,F,F),
           c(T,F,T,F),
           c(T,F,F,T),
           c(F,T,T,F),
           c(F,T,F,T),
           c(F,F,T,T),
           c(T,T,T,F),
           c(T,T,F,T),
           c(T,F,T,T),
           c(F,T,T,T),
           c(T,T,T,T))

order = c(1,6,3,12,
          16,11,14,5,
          9,2,4,7,
          8,15,13,10)

for(i in 1:16){
    ii = order[i]
    # cat("\\begin{minipage}[t]{0.18\\linewidth}\n")
    drawit(tfs[[ii]])
    cat("\n\n\\vspace{-0.3in}")
    for(jj in labs[[ii]]){
        cat(paste0("$$",jj,"$$\n"))
    }
    # cat("\\end{minipage}\n\\begin{minipage}[t]{0.8\\linewidth}\n")
    
    # cat("\n\\end{minipage}\n")
    cat("\n\\vfill\n\n")
    
    if(i%%4==0){
        cat("\n\\newpage\n\n")
    }
}
```
